cheatsWarning: PowerPyx reports that cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep cheats off the save you use for the platinum.
list: Official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden; no online trophies. Names, descriptions and grades as published on PlayStation, cross-checked against Exophase (crawled 2026-11-20) and PSNProfiles; the two agreed on every name, description and grade.
platinumEstimate: PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours; one playthrough is enough and no online play is needed.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5): https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/ — official names, descriptions, hidden flags
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi — grades and PSN progress targets

PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — difficulty 4/10, ~200 hours, counts (397 stunts, 42 shooting range challenges, 14 drone race locations, 18 meditation spots, 80 challenges, 18 card sets, 9 activity types, 8 bank vaults, 8 garages), cheats warning, missable flag
GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies: https://gamemapa.com/en/gta-6/guides/gta-6-trophy-achievement-list/ — cross-checked counts and roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List: https://sixshore.com/gta-6/guides/trophies-and-achievements/ — cross-checked counts and missable note
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap: https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/ — cross-checked list and counts

trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no separate task, no online requirement and no DLC involved — just work through the roadmap in order (story, side strands, activities, collectibles, then the 100% cleanup) and it pops last. PowerPyx rates the whole journey about 200 hours at 4/10 difficulty, all in a single playthrough.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: PowerPyx — platinum needs no online play or DLC; ~200 hours, 4/10

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: play the opening mission Gone Fishing and finish it. It is the first mission of the game, so it unlocks within your first session — there is nothing to prepare and nothing you can do wrong. If it has not popped, you have simply not finished the mission yet.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every mission in Chapter 1. Just follow the story markers in order; the trophy pops at the chapter's closing mission. Nothing in Chapter 1 needs to be done in a special order for trophies, so play naturally and save often.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every mission in Chapter 2. Keep playing the story in order and it unlocks at the chapter finale. Chapter 2 is also a good time to start the open-world habits that pay off later — try activities as you pass them and scan things with WAiNK — but nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every mission in Chapter 3. The trophy pops at the chapter's final mission. By now the map is well opened up, so between story missions it is worth clearing nearby collectibles and activities rather than leaving them all for after the story.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every mission in Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. The bank-vault robberies tied to the Maximum Withdrawal trophy open through an optional mission in this chapter, so take that mission when it appears rather than rushing straight to the finale.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Sixshore — bank jobs open through an optional Chapter 4 mission

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable, and the gold for finishing the game: complete the final mission after Chapter 4. Once the credits roll, free roam stays open, so anything you have not finished — side strands, collectibles, challenges — can still be done afterwards. Do not worry about wrapping everything up before the finale.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: PowerPyx — one playthrough is enough; free roam continues after the story

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. It unlocks by playing the main missions in order — there is no side requirement and no way to skip past it. Just follow the mission markers.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It is a main-story heist, so it arrives in the normal mission flow — play the story in order and it pops when the heist is done. Stock up on armour and ammo before starting, as with any big story job.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission Child's Play in the main story. It cannot be missed — it is part of the mission chain, and finishing it is the only requirement. Play the story markers in order and it unlocks.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission Headliners. Like the other named-mission trophies, it is awarded for finishing that story mission and nothing else. Follow the story in order; there is no optional step attached to it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission VCIA Takedown, the airport job at Vice City International Airport. It pops when the mission is finished. The airport is also the setting for the Catch Me If You Can trophy, so remember the layout — you will come back here in free roam.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a main-story mission, so it unlocks in the normal flow — no side content is needed. Finish the mission and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The second gold and the hardest trophy in the set: reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which appears under Progress > Stats after the story. It is a long checklist — story, stunts (300 of 397 count toward 100%), stranger strands, collectibles, activities and more — so treat it as the final cleanup phase, not a first-playthrough goal. Work through the checklist line by line in free roam after the finale; every other trophy feeds into it, and when the checklist hits 100% this pops, leaving only the platinum itself.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: GameMapa — 100% checklist appears after the story under Progress > Stats

trophies.guide: Silver for stunt work: complete any 250 stunts across Leonida — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in total, so you do not need them all for this trophy, but 100% completion needs 300. The in-game map and stunt markers are your checklist; work through them region by region in free roam, and retry failed jumps from the nearest road rather than driving back across the map.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: PowerPyx — 397 stunts total across jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights, base jumps

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample everything Leonida offers: try each of the 9 activity types once — the game's activities include things like fishing, shooting range, drone racing, bowling, arcade games and more. You do not need to win or finish any of them, just start and complete one session of each type. Work through them as you meet them during the story and side content; the tracker in this guide lists the types so you can tick them off as you go.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver and one of the skill-based grinds: earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge has its own par score for gold, so learn the range's scoring — accuracy beats speed on most of them — and replay a challenge immediately while the layout is fresh in your head. Bring your best-handling weapons, take your time on the first run to learn the targets, then push for gold. None of the ranges are missable, so you can return any time.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: KeenGamer — all 42 Shooting Range gold medals

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location hosts its own race course, so the task is breadth, not one perfect run: visit every race spot on the map and win each one. Learn each course's corners on a practice pass, then race for the win — drones handle very differently from cars, so brake early and cut the racing line. All 14 spots stay available in free roam.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Leonida's race scene covers street races, off-road and more; enter events through their map markers and work through the list. Pick a fast, well-handling car for road races and keep it upgraded, learn each route's braking points, and use the rewind-friendly approach of retrying a race you lose rather than grinding one you have already won.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and beat him. Fishing challenges are head-to-head: land the better catch within the challenge's rules, watching the line tension so it never snaps. Pick a quiet spot, use the best rod and bait you have, and retry the challenge if Cal out-fishes you — the challenge stays available. This is also a good way to learn the fishing activity for the Master of None trophy.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: KeenGamer — beat Cal in a fishing challenge

trophies.guide: Find an arcade cabinet and finish one full game on it. Arcades are scattered around Vice City and the wider state — walk up to a machine, start a game and play it to its end (or its game-over screen with a completed run, depending on the cabinet). Any single completed arcade game counts, so pick the cabinet you enjoy most and finish it.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Side-strand trophy: follow Andy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Stranger and side-character strands unlock as you play the story — their markers appear on the map, and each strand is a short chain ending in a finale. Do Andy's missions when they appear rather than leaving them all for the end, and this pops at the last one.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Side-strand trophy: complete Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission. Like the other named-character strands, Kenton's chain appears on the map as you progress the story. Play each mission when it shows up and the trophy unlocks at the finale — no extra collectible or side task is attached.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Side-strand trophy: finish Billy's mission strand with its final mission. Billy's missions unlock in the story flow; clear them as they appear so the strand does not pile up at the end. The trophy is awarded for the finale alone — there is no hidden requirement beyond completing the chain.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver for side content: complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions are the question-mark encounters on the map — each is a short chain with its own characters and payoff. PowerPyx notes it is still confirming exactly which strands count toward the eight, so work through every stranger marker you find rather than stopping at eight: finishing more strands is never wasted, and several feed the 100% checklist too. All strands stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: Sixshore — 8 stranger strands; PowerPyx still confirming which qualify

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Side-strand trophy: complete Randy's mission strand through to its final mission. Randy's chain shows up on the map as the story opens up the state — take the missions as they appear. Finish the finale and the trophy pops; nothing else is required.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Side-strand trophy: complete Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission. Play Tyrone's missions when their markers appear and the trophy unlocks at the last one. Like the other character strands, it is self-contained — no collectible or activity requirement is attached.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE TROPHY TO WATCH: PowerPyx and GTABase both flag this as the only possibly missable trophy in the game. There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida, and at least one is tied to a Chapter 1 area that may become hard to revisit, so meditate at every spot you find as soon as you find it — do not leave them for post-story cleanup. Use the in-game map markers and this guide's checklist: visit a spot, meditate, and tick it off before moving on. If you are already past Chapter 1, check the spots you can still reach first and keep the rest on your list.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: PowerPyx — 18 meditation spots; flagged as possibly missable
GameMapa — the one trophy you might miss
Sixshore — one trophy may be missable in Chapter 1

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret wants a specific, unique animal hunted — not just any wildlife. Track the animal through its territory using the hunting clues the game gives you (tracks, calls, habitat hints), then take it down cleanly. Hunting is one of Leonida's activities, so bring a scoped rifle, stay downwind and be patient: the unique animal only counts when it is the right one, so confirm the target before you shoot.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Silver for collectors: complete 3 full collectible card sets out of 18 sets in the game. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, interiors and out-of-the-way spots — so pick up every card you see and track which sets are near completion. You only need 3 of the 18 sets, so focus on the sets where you already hold most cards and trade or hunt down the last few, rather than trying to finish all 18.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Silver for exploring with the WAiNK app: scan 100 locations — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures — with the in-game WAiNK camera app. Open WAiNK, point it at a point of interest and scan; each new location counts once. The habit pays off double: scanning also discovers vehicles for the Whip It Good trophy. Walk the cities and the countryside with WAiNK open and scan everything that prompts you, and the 100 will come naturally across the playthrough.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: GameMapa — scan 100 spots: landmarks, curiosities, sculptures

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges. Challenges are the small goals layered over everything you do — driving, shooting, exploring, activities — and they tick off as you play, so this is a trophy that mostly earns itself if you play broadly. Check the Challenges menu regularly, pick off the ones close to completion (a few more of a stunt type, a few more scans), and you will pass 50 well before you finish the other grinds.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. The trick is the escape, not the crime: get the heat up (robberies and shootouts raise it fast), then break line of sight, switch vehicles, and use alleys, tunnels and the countryside to shake the search circle. Do it with your partner in the car or on foot beside you — the trophy needs them with you when the wanted level clears.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — the chain breaks if the heat drops to zero between robberies. Plan a route of three nearby shops, hit them fast one after another, and keep moving between them so the wanted level stays live. Avoid killing cops unnecessarily (it raises the stars and the pressure); speed and a getaway car parked close to each door matter more than firepower.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida. A WAiNK scan is enough to register a vehicle as discovered, so keep the WAiNK app handy whenever you see a new car, bike, boat or aircraft — scan first, drive later. Variety is the point: traffic in different districts, parked rarities, and mission vehicles all count. This pairs naturally with the WAiNK It trophy, so do them together.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: GameMapa — discover 100 vehicles; a WAiNK scan is enough

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus (the game's slow-motion targeting) and take down 5 enemies before it ends. Set it up: pick a fight with a group of enemies in the open, wait until five are in view, then trigger Combat Focus and work through them quickly, prioritising the closest threats. Missions with waves of enemies are ideal — retry a mission checkpoint if the first attempt falls short.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, leave by air without a scheduled flight — steal a plane and take off. Get onto the airfield (the story's VCIA Takedown mission shows you the layout), grab an aircraft, and get airborne before security stops you. Any runway departure in a stolen plane counts; keep it simple and take off as soon as you are in the cockpit.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: This trophy is about the Rhino tank: get into one and survive the heat that follows — the description's joke is the clue, since a stolen tank brings the army down on you fast. Find a Rhino (they appear at high wanted levels and at military spots), climb in, and keep it rolling while the wanted level climbs. Use the cannon to clear roadblocks ahead of you and keep moving; sitting still is what gets you killed.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Stealth robbery: rob a jewelry store without ever being detected. Plan it like a quiet job — case the store, go in when the street is empty, move slowly, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails: leave, lose any heat, and try again. Patience beats speed here.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Silver for heist work: rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4, and there are 8 vaults in total, so you only need 5 of them — but 100% completion needs all 8, so consider doing them all. For each vault, plan the entry, grab the cash, and escape cleanly before the response closes in; a fast getaway car and a pre-planned route out of town make the escape far easier than improvising under fire.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Sixshore — bank jobs open through an optional Chapter 4 mission; 8 vaults, 100% needs all 8

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Classic GTA job: rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around the state — spot one, stop it (block the road or disable it), crack it open, take the cash and get away before the police box you in. Pick a quiet stretch of road for the hit and have a fast car waiting; the escape matters as much as the robbery.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Visit every area of Leonida — the whole state, from Vice City's beaches and downtown to the swamps, farmland and small towns. The game tracks which areas you have set foot in, so drive the full map methodically: work region by region, use roads you have not taken, and check the map for blank patches. Pair this with WAiNK scanning and vehicle discovery, and the exploration trophies will finish together.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Hit the gangs where it hurts: rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Gang operations are marked on the map once you find them — each gang runs its own rackets, so work through the gang list one by one and clear an operation for each. Expect armed resistance at every site; go in prepared and get out with the take before reinforcements arrive.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A quiet one: go to Ocean Beach, find a bar or beach spot with a view, and enjoy a cocktail there. This is a hidden trophy whose exact trigger the guides were still pinning down at launch — the description is the instruction, so head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail at a beachfront bar and take in the view. If it does not pop at the first bar, try another beachfront spot along the strip.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: GameMapa — PowerPyx lists this trophy's conditions as still unconfirmed; description is the guide

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy with a cinematic trigger: drive a car straight out through a vehicle showroom's frontage, smashing your way out in classic GTA style. Pick a showroom, get a car inside or lined up at the glass, and floor it through the front. Guides at launch still listed the exact showroom as unconfirmed, so if one showroom does not trigger it, try another — the act itself is what the description asks for.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: GameMapa — PowerPyx lists this trophy's conditions as still unconfirmed

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — play a full game there. The alley is the named location, so do not just bowl anywhere: find the Kolt & Associates alley, rent a lane and bowl through a complete game. This also counts toward trying the activity types for Master of None, so it is an easy early win.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A hidden trophy about the partnership at the heart of the game — Lucia and Jason, the two protagonists. The description gives no concrete task, and guides at launch had not pinned down a single trigger, so the honest advice is: play the story co-operatively with your partner, do partner activities and missions together, and keep an eye on the trophy guides as the community confirms the exact condition. It is tied to the partnership, not to any missable moment, so it should unlock through normal partner play.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: GameMapa — conditions for this hidden trophy still unconfirmed at launch

trophies.guide: A hidden trophy about making choices — the game tracks the decisions you make across the story and the open world, for better or worse. There is no single action to perform: make choices when the game offers them (dialogue options, approach choices, side decisions) and keep playing, and the trophy pops once the counter behind it is met. It is not missable — choices keep coming through the story and free roam.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: GameMapa — hidden trophy, conditions still being confirmed

trophies.guide: A hidden trophy whose name is the hint: succeed on a second attempt. If you fail something — a mission, a challenge, a stunt — and then succeed on the retry, this is the trophy that rewards persistence. Guides at launch had not confirmed one exact trigger, so the practical advice is simple: do not fear failing. Retry what you miss, and the second-time success will come naturally during a normal playthrough.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: GameMapa — hidden trophy, conditions still being confirmed

trophies.guide: A hidden trophy for witnessing something strange — Leonida is full of odd encounters, easter eggs and random events. Roam the state, follow strange map markers and stranger encounters, and pay attention when something out of the ordinary happens. Guides at launch listed this one as still unconfirmed, so the best approach is to explore widely and let the weird find you; the community's confirmed trigger will be added to this guide as it is verified.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: GameMapa — hidden trophy, conditions still being confirmed

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, knock someone over with a melee weapon. Get a melee weapon equipped, drive slowly past a pedestrian, and swing as you pass — the trophy is about the drive-by, not a shooting. Do it in a quiet area to keep the wanted level low, and use a slow vehicle so you can time the swing. One clean hit is all it takes.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — they cannot be spent directly, so take them to your laundering contacts, who clean a cut of each batch for usable cash. Keep laundering after every big job rather than stockpiling the bills, and the $250,000 total will build up across the playthrough. Bank vaults and armored trucks are the best sources of Marked Bills.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: KeenGamer — launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through contacts

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops in Leonida — weapons, clothes, cars, food, anything that costs money. This earns itself over a long playthrough: buy the gear you actually want, keep your vehicles upgraded, and shop normally. If you are close at the end, the fastest top-up is an expensive vehicle or weapon purchase. It is cumulative across every shop, so every dollar counts.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties in Leonida. Garages are purchasable properties that give you somewhere to store vehicles — find them on the map or through the in-game property listings, and buy them as your cash allows. They are not cheap, so save this for the mid-to-late game when heists and laundering have built up your funds; the $100,000 spending trophy will thank you too.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone and register 10 vehicles to it. Find vehicles around Leonida — different cars, bikes and more — and add each one to the app; each new registration counts once. Work through a variety of vehicles rather than registering the same model twice, and use the discovery habit from Whip It Good: see a new vehicle, scan it, then register it.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: KeenGamer — register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app
